peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 9.3% above its local comparables; 87 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (81.0): 5.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 87 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 95.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $822,500 ($1,911 psf, 409–516 sq ft; 6 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,682 psf (range $1,626–2,129); 13.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $99,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,438,888 ($1,894 psf, 613–861 sq ft; 29 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,803 psf (range $1,715–2,192); 5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $69,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Lakeside MRT about 290 m, Chinese Garden MRT about 980 m; closer than 75 of 116 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 10 within 2 km; nearest Shuqun Primary School about 360 m; more than 39 of 116 similar developments (the same as 35). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 310 m), more than 54 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Jurong West Street 52 Blk 505 about 770 m; nearest park JLG: Lakeside Garden about 80 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Lakegarden Residences, 61 new sales, about 1,060 m; Sora, 41 new sales, about 1,270 m; Tengah Garden Residences, 863 new sales, about 1,390 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 20 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,070 new sales and 229 resales (1,299 purchases); new sales were 82.4% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Lucerne Grand (launch, under construction), about 510 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 229 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 21 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 229 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 232 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−1.3%). Planning-area private resales −1.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
